question.prompt: The probability of a hit on a single shot is \(1/2\). The complement of at least 1 hit is misses on all 3 shots. What is the probability of at least 1 hit in 3 independent shots?

solutions.explanation:
Each shot misses with probability \(1-\frac12=\frac12\). Since the shots are independent, the probability of missing all three is
\[
\left(\frac12\right)^3=\frac18.
\]
At least one hit is the complementary event, so its probability is \(1−1/8=7/8\).
solutions.title: Take the complementary probability
